profile.name: Cassiopeia J P
profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Citizens Advice SORT
profile.bio: I build digital tools with TypeScript, Next.js, Python, and FastAPI. Day to day I work with developers and non-developers at Citizens Advice SORT in Manchester. Outside work I make art and write.

experience.summary: Part of a team building and shipping digital solutions with TypeScript, Next.js, Python, and FastAPI, through AWS and GCP, with a focus on AI tools that support charity work.

achievements.text: Laid foundations for SCPs (Simulated Client Personas) in a new agentic training platform, grounded in voice-to-text transcription and evaluation.
Built a platform to support clients on their PIP journey. The tool is meant as a gateway to an appointment and is projected to cut appointment times by 60%.
Wrote design, development, and architecture docs for team projects, and pushed GitHub project boards as the way we track tasks and issues.
Attended shareholder meetings to talk with funders about the fund and the direction of the project their award supported.
Made the case for rebuilding the internal expenses app and led the new build in React and Node.js with a Python backend and Firebase.
Shipped the first accessibility features on two training platforms and pushed to roll them out across the product catalogue.

experience.summary: Supported staff with CRM and site issues, set up an online tutor schedule, and handled marketing tasks and hardware upkeep.

achievements.text: Researched and reached out to potential clients, and set up and ran the online tutor schedule.
Kept the CRM and website updated and running.
Designed adverts and worked with the marketing manager on distribution.

experience.summary: Volunteer work on a print magazine for the group's 20th anniversary: designed assets and edited copy for readability.

achievements.text: Designed print assets for the 20th anniversary magazine, including cover, layout, and content.
Drafted and edited copy so it read clearly and stayed accurate.
Worked with a volunteer group through to print, on time.

experience.summary: Prepared and served food, including drive-thru, plus standard cleaning duties.

achievements.text: Prepared and served food, mainly back of house work such as fry cooking, plus cleaning.
Worked with the team to keep the store running smoothly.

education.summary: Software Development pathway while working full-time. Left when I was not learning enough and wanted to focus on my own projects and skills.
Two-year technical qualification with industry placement and a 70-hour client project: a full-stack website and documentation.

achievements.text: Completed the T-Level with passing grades in all modules.
Finished a 70-hour client project: full-stack site and docs, with a passing grade.
Learned HTML, CSS, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python, database systems, and SQLite.
Completed 360 hours of industry placement.

education.summary: Core academic subjects from the required UK school curriculum.

achievements.text: Finished Creative iMedia coursework in the first 6 months of the 2-year course, with a Distinction at Level 2.
Planned and built a physical 3D Design model after the teacher was injured early in the course and was absent for most of it.
Completed Art, Craft and Design coursework with a grade 4, focused on multi-media production and design.
